rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the value a person assigns to themselves or their abilities.

example.english: A person's self-worth should not be determined by their salary.
example.traditional: 一個人嘅自我價值，唔應該由人工高低去決定。
example.jyutping: jat1 go3 jan4 ge3 zi6 ngo5 gaa3 zik6 m4 jing1 goi1 jau4 jan4 gung1 gou1 dai1 heoi3 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use this when the context emphasizes a person's sense of dignity or self-respect rather than an assessment of their abilities.

example.english: After being humiliated in public, they still had to pretend nothing happened; it really hurt their self-worth.
example.traditional: 畀人當眾羞辱之後，佢仲要扮冇事，真係好傷自尊心。
example.jyutping: bei2 jan4 dong1 zung3 sau1 juk6 zi1 hau6 keoi5 zung6 jiu3 baan6 mou5 si6 zan1 hai6 hou2 soeng1 zi6 zyun1 sam1
